questions.prompt: How many litres of water does one person use at home each day?
reasoning: One shower is ~60 litres and a few toilet flushes add ~30 more.
Cooking, laundry and taps make up the rest — roughly one full bathtub.

questions.prompt: How many countries are there in Africa?
reasoning: Africa has 54 fully recognised states — more than any other continent.
The world total is 195, so Africa holds over a quarter of them.

questions.prompt: How many commercial flights take off around the world each day?
reasoning: The busiest airports handle ~1,500 departures a day each, and there are thousands of airports.
